entities.name: Augusta Foote Arnold
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Augusta Newton Foote Arnold was an American author and naturalist who published three books – two cookery books under the pen name of Mary Ronald, and The Sea-Beach at Ebb-Tide, regarded as a seminal work on the intertidal biology of the United States.
